# Security Checklist: SPEC-014B - Harness Adapter Manifest and Fake Registry

**Purpose**: Validate fake harness manifest, runtime inventory, sanitized evidence, auth/scope, and read-only boundary security requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-06-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Authorization And Scope

- [x] CHK001 Are unauthenticated, viewer-or-higher, workspace, project, and task visibility requirements defined before runtime inventory derivation? [Security, Spec §Runtime Inventory API Scope]
- [x] CHK002 Are unauthorized resource filters required to return bounded responses without revealing identifier existence outside caller-visible scope? [Security, Contract §Authorization And Scope]
- [x] CHK003 Are top-level request authorization and filter errors required to omit partial `entries`? [Security, Contract §Error Responses]

## Sanitized Evidence Boundary

- [x] CHK004 Is the `sanitized_fake_evidence.v1` allowlist closed and traceable across spec, data model, contract, and quickstart? [Completeness, Spec §Sanitized Fake Evidence]
- [x] CHK005 Are raw transcripts, provider payloads, host paths, prompt bodies, token payloads, auth material, secret-like values, raw events, raw tool/MCP payloads, unsafe URIs, and artifact content prohibited before API/UI/log/test/review exposure? [Security, Spec §FR-046]
- [x] CHK006 Are unsafe evidence failures specified as fail-closed `sanitized_evidence_rejected` outcomes instead of redaction-and-continue behavior? [Security, Spec §FR-047]
- [x] CHK007 Are text-bearing evidence and diagnostic fields required to be plain text only, reject secret-shaped values, and avoid raw HTML/Markdown interpretation? [Resolved, Spec §FR-060]

## Manifest Validation Safety

- [x] CHK008 Are manifest validation payloads bounded to field paths, closed codes, reason codes, optional evidence kind, rejected property names, and capped diagnostics? [Security, Spec §Manifest Validation Failure Payload]
- [x] CHK009 Are raw manifest values, schema excerpts, validator exception text, stack traces, provider payloads, credentials, prompts, tokens, and host paths explicitly excluded from validation errors? [Security, Data Model §HarnessManifestValidation]
- [x] CHK010 Are unknown manifest properties and missing required capability declarations specified as validation failures rather than ignored defaults? [Security, Spec §Manifest Capability Support Shape]

## Read-Only And Side-Effect Boundary

- [x] CHK011 Are launch, assignment, lifecycle, claim, retry, scheduler, GitHub, governance, tracker-truth, successor, and auto-merge mutations excluded from the runtime inventory API? [Security, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK012 Are real Codex, Claude, OpenClaw, Hermes, OpenCode, provider API, gateway RPC, external harness process, scheduler, and shell command calls excluded from fake adapter behavior? [Security, Spec §FR-051]
- [x] CHK013 Are unsupported capabilities and policies required to fail closed without fallback adapter selection or state mutation? [Security, Spec §FR-043]

## Provider And Credential Safety

- [x] CHK014 Are v1 provider/account constraints synthetic-only with no real provider kind, account binding, credential reference, credential material, prompt body, or provider payload exposure? [Security, Spec §Manifest Policy And Provider/Account Constraints]
- [x] CHK015 Is real provider/account binding explicitly deferred to later real-adapter specs and a new security review? [Security, Spec §Manifest Policy And Provider/Account Constraints]
- [x] CHK016 Are fake artifact descriptors limited to metadata and digest/reference evidence rather than artifact content? [Security, Data Model §SanitizedFakeEvidence]

## Verification Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Do quickstart and success criteria require verification of sanitized evidence rejection and absence of unsafe payload exposure? [Coverage, Quickstart §Sanitized Evidence Verification]
- [x] CHK018 Are static guards or tests required to prove no real harness execution, gateway call, external process launch, scheduler dispatch, migration, mutation, or auto-merge path is introduced? [Security, Spec §FR-052]
- [x] CHK019 Are UI requirements consistent with the sanitized evidence boundary and prohibited from exposing unsafe payloads in visible text or screenshots? [Consistency, Spec §Agents Surface UX Contract]
- [x] CHK020 Are all security-sensitive outputs traceable to bounded schemas or closed reason-code vocabularies? [Traceability, Spec §Fail-Closed Reason Codes, Data Model §HarnessAdapterReasonCode]
